This is one of the smartest ways to utilise Claude Fable 5 right now.

The model is very powerful, but the rate limit is strict. So instead of directly telling “make a new feature” or “refactor this”, it is more effective to give an in-depth audit first + a structured improvement plan. This prompt makes AI work systematically, evidence-based, and actionable — not just theory.

Especially for those who have important repo (side project, startup codebase, or internal tool), this can be a game changer. Immediately increase the quality of the codebase, security, and maintainability without having to think from scratch.

Additional tips from me:

• Start from the most critical repo first (the one that makes money or core product).

• Save the audit output as Markdown, so that it is easy to review with the team.

• After the audit is completed, then use Fable (or other models) to execute task by task.

Thank you @x-user-2 for sharing this high quality prompt. The more people who use this level of prompt engineering, the faster we all level up.
